categories.name: Initial visual impression
categories.note: The reference has denser massing and terrain with water. QSimCity is interactive in about a second where the reference showed roughly 60 seconds of staged loading, and shows all twelve districts in one frame.

categories.name: Skyline originality
categories.note: Entirely procedural geometry with no third-party assets; each district kit produces a distinct silhouette.

categories.name: District differentiation
categories.note: Twelve accent-coloured plates with different part vocabularies and named landmarks; the reference uses roughly eight larger zones with denser interiors.

categories.name: Long-distance readability
categories.note: Every district is legible in one frame with labels floating above the silhouette.

categories.name: Medium-distance data-flow clarity
categories.note: Geography is the pipeline: west-to-east ordering matches processing order and the boulevard physically connects the stages.

categories.name: First-person detail
categories.note: Buildings loom at eye height and consoles are approachable; the reference has more street-level clutter.

categories.name: Orbit camera
categories.note: Drag-rotate, wheel zoom, clamped to city bounds.

categories.name: Top-down camera
categories.note: Plan view showing the whole pipeline layout.

categories.name: Walking camera
categories.note: Eye height 1.7 with AABB collision; entry always steps toward the built-up centre so the viewer is never stranded outside the city.

categories.name: Day mode
categories.note: QSimCity now has an atmospheric horizon, but the reference still has richer terrain including water.

categories.name: Night mode
categories.note: Window lights, starfield, and emissive district glow; the reference night mode is a dimmer variant of its day scene.

categories.name: Touch and mobile presentation
categories.note: Touch is verified in an automated mobile profile; the reference documents emulation-only testing.

categories.name: Inspector integration
categories.note: Selection shows role, live state, provenance, certainty, and jump-to-timeline actions.

categories.name: Semantic animation
categories.note: Every motion is trace-driven; nothing decorative moves and no amplitude is animated as transported cargo.

categories.name: Loading presentation
categories.note: QSimCity reaches an interactive city in about a second; the reference displayed a sequence of loading captions for roughly a minute before the city appeared.

categories.name: Visual accessibility
categories.note: A complete non-WebGL mode, axe-clean WCAG 2.2 AA, and never colour alone; the reference requires WebGL2.

categories.name: Overall polish
categories.note: Consistent design system, clean console across four browsers, no clipped or overlapping text.

reference.state: live deployment of its main branch, 220 commits
